summary: Negros Oriental 3rd District representative with 113 principal-authored bills. Authored a nurses' minimum wage, a government procurement transparency portal, an anti-dynasty ban, tighter rules on nuisance candidates and travel-tax abolition.
caveat: Bills only; no oversight conduct or votes reviewed. Economic 0 reflects labor-protective and tax-cut bills pulling opposite ways.

economic.label: Center / mixed
economic.rationale: Authored minimum wage for private-sector nurses (-2) versus travel-tax abolition (+2). Two issues, thin.
